label: location, depth and surface geology
training_data: NX2_minus_satellite/data.csv (2827 train / 707 test wells, stratified 80/20 split, fixed random state)
target: Safe10 = arsenic <= 10 ug/L (class 1 = safe, class 0 = unsafe)
classifier: LightGBM (best of nine on the held-out split, the rule the paper reports)
preprocessing: IterativeImputer -> VarianceThreshold -> Pearson(0.9) -> StandardScaler (fit on the training split only)
probabilities: raw predict_proba, uncalibrated, identical to the study run
disclaimer: This is an estimate from environmental data, not a water test. It cannot certify a well as safe. Confirm arsenic by testing the actual well water.
